---
name: plan
description: Plan a feature before implementation
agent: ask
argument-hint: Describe the feature or change
---
Use the `bmad-spec` and `bmad-architecture` skills. Read the relevant docs and
code. Do not edit files. Summarize scope, existing components affected, API and
data changes, security/configuration impact, ordered implementation steps,
verification commands, risks, and open questions. Ask only questions that block
a sound plan. Keep recommendations consistent with this repository's current
Spring Boot, pgvector, S3-compatible storage, and Compose setup.
